contractScope: Lume Vale capability-test preset visuals. This contract covers code-native skin-light artifacts, reveal visuals, treatment routing, consultation journey, and aftercare proof surfaces.

visualItems.title: Skin-Light Diagnostic
visualItems.serviceValue: Clinical clarity shown through translucent skin-layer light, not generic beauty ambience.
visualItems.requiredSubject: translucent skin-layer light study with visible tone, texture, and diagnostic glow cues
visualItems.assetSource: LumeDiagnosticTheatre code-native diagnostic chamber with macro skin texture field, translucent light sheet, scan window, and private treatment readout
visualItems.semanticFit: The artifact makes Lume Vale feel like a private diagnostic clinic surface rather than a generic abstract beauty blob, supporting careful assessment before treatment.
visualItems.fallbackSubject: subject-led skin layer map with diagnostic glow and tone texture flow
visualItems.visualProofNote: Verify the hero visual reads as skin-light diagnostic material and not a decorative placeholder at desktop, 390px, and 412px.

visualItems.title: Lume Reveal
visualItems.serviceValue: A privacy-safe reveal that explains gradual tone, texture, and glow improvement.
visualItems.requiredSubject: interactive skin reveal showing concern state to calmer tone and smoother texture over time
visualItems.assetSource: Custom LumeReveal interaction using layered macro skin fields, concern-map markers, planned-care overlay, staged treatment rail, and a draggable reveal handle
visualItems.semanticFit: The visual demonstrates staged tone, barrier, and texture planning while avoiding unlicensed before-after faces or unrealistic claims.
visualItems.fallbackSubject: subject-led skin reveal map with calmer tone, texture flow, and gradual treatment comparison
visualItems.visualProofNote: Verify the reveal works on desktop, remains usable on mobile, and falls back to a polished static split under reduced motion.

visualItems.title: Treatment Intent Map
visualItems.serviceValue: Treatment options grouped by client concern so inquiry feels specific and safe.
visualItems.requiredSubject: concern routing map for glow, acne marks, pigmentation, hair revival, bridal prep, and subtle refinement
visualItems.assetSource: Treatment grid and LumeSkinPlate intent artifact with concern nodes and skin-plan routing lines
visualItems.semanticFit: The visual system groups treatments by concern and links each surface to a WhatsApp intent, making conversion specific rather than menu-like.
visualItems.fallbackSubject: subject-led treatment map with skin concern nodes and routing flow
visualItems.visualProofNote: Verify the treatment map reads as concern-led care and that every card is tappable without mobile overflow.

visualItems.title: Private Consultation Path
visualItems.serviceValue: A calm consultation journey that makes privacy, safety, and aftercare visible.
visualItems.requiredSubject: scan, plan, treat, and maintain journey with private skin consultation flow cues
visualItems.assetSource: Consultation journey section with four process steps and private skin-plan language
visualItems.semanticFit: The section makes the consultation process visible through precise steps, helping visitors understand privacy, preparation, treatment, and maintenance.
visualItems.fallbackSubject: subject-led private skin consultation flow with scan plan treat maintain stages
visualItems.visualProofNote: Verify the journey does not look like generic process cards and remains readable at 390px and 412px.

visualItems.title: Aftercare Lattice
visualItems.serviceValue: Transformation proof is grounded in timeline, aftercare, and maintenance discipline.
visualItems.requiredSubject: aftercare lattice, skin maintenance flow, treatment timeline, and privacy-safe proof structure
visualItems.assetSource: LumeSkinPlate aftercare artifact with lattice lines plus proof rows for goal, timeline, and aftercare cue
visualItems.semanticFit: The proof surface avoids fake client photos and instead ties transformation claims to timeline, maintenance, and aftercare discipline.
visualItems.fallbackSubject: subject-led skin aftercare lattice with maintenance flow and treatment timeline cues
visualItems.visualProofNote: Verify the proof section communicates credible transformation support without relying on captions alone.
